To get the best results with your mattress, here are the care and setup basics: 
Use a mattress protector to prevent damage.
If you aren’t using a protector, you can remove the Breathable Quilted Mattress Cover by the zipper and spot clean with a mild detergent and water. The top half of this cover (the white and grey micro-quilted fabric) is also machine washable in cold water and should be air-dried. Machine drying will shrink the Breathable Quilted Mattress Cover.

Place it on a proper foundation and don’t use it directly on the floor (a traditional frame with a box spring, or a slatted frame, helps support airflow).
